partition_policy.similarity_limit: SequenceMatcher is a screening measure, not proof of semantic independence. All 172 candidates were read semantically; parent must also compare new app dev/test before final freeze.

local_validator.selected_source_quality: Every retained original has intent_score=1, slots_score=1, grammar_score>=3 for all supplied judgments. These judgments do not assess remapped labels or adapted text.

semantic_review.input_boundary: text is the only classifier input. Slots, source labels, original_text, annotation and group are metadata, not BERT inputs.
semantic_review.raw_mapping_policy: fact, method and state questions map to not_command; explicit unsupported action requests map to out_of_scope_request. Question-form requests remain actions. Nominal/plan/unknown-reference ambiguities were rejected.
semantic_review.derived_policy: 14 existing dispatch-oriented labels, six examples each before dedup. No model-output claim. Known pending capabilities such as text frames and clip_to_panel remain pending.
